public_contract.constructor: Car is created at track[0] position and stored beta, before wrapper warmup.
public_contract.road: Tile half-width40/6 m and nominal generated step21/6 m. Per-generation turn update capped0.31; this is not a universal closing-seam or topology guarantee.
public_contract.warmup: Wrapper performs50 no-op steps and tiles the final image4 times. Collisions/termination may affect pose, so exact constructor pose is not assumed after warmup.
public_contract.obstacles: Centers exclude first10% and last5% of track indices, not a Euclidean ball. No spatial absence or hidden-obstacle clearance is inferred.

implementation.initial_only: Low observed speed, visible paired flanks, nominal spawn centering/orientation and public road width condition local support.
implementation.after_initial: No spawn position/direction prior. Only paired visible boundary continuity, observed normal width and actual temporal evidence support the local connected-road hypothesis.
implementation.rejected_support: No bridging across non-vehicle visible grass gaps, missing flanks, abrupt/over-wide geometry or observed obstacles. Clear rows outside a bad band can remain supported.

public_checks.scope: Finite practical conditioning tests, not a universal uncertainty bound.

privacy: Only code and aggregates are committed. No seed, true map or external state enters Agent; raw checkpoints remain private.
remaining_blocker: Initialization is no longer the blocker. The original estimated-input forecast still finds no admissible candidate near the first bend. Stopped at that first failure; no gate change, retry, or further rollout.
